text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having finished the first three years of 
the Twinkle Series—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, Seeking the Pearl finally made 
her European tour a reality. And then—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: （Wooooooooooooooooooooow！！）

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Ohohoho! Hello, world♪ How did you like 
watching my run up close?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
That was excellent, wouldn't you say? Now 
with this—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"...I have zero regrets. Not a single 
one."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Following that victory, Seeking the Pearl 
—vanished without a trace.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Disappeared from Tracen Academy.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's you, Trainer. Yes, Seeking the 
Pearl's registration is still maintained.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"It's not like she submitted withdrawal 
papers herself. I wonder where she could 
be right now..."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Even as student council president, I can't 
figure out what she's thinking. Broad as 
the open sea and sky... Her perspective is 
just too vast.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And then, after even more years had 
passed, one day—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! Pearl-san's... I found out where 
Pearl-san is desu!!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Where Pearl-san is right now—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
USA! Kentucky! A message saying "I'm at 
the ranch where Papi was"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Unable to sit still any longer, I flew to 
America. And then...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The one who welcomed me at the ranch— was 
a young Umamusume girl.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...When I mimicked the laughter, the girl 
pointed. And there, right in front of 
us...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Ohohoho! Yes, inspiration has struck! All 
thanks to that lightning!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
This is a whole new possibility! Although 
I almost got myself cooked well-done in 
the process.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Oh, Trainer. It's been a while.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Welcome! And I've been waiting! I was 
waiting for you to come pick me up.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There were mountains of things I wanted to 
ask. Above all, what I wanted to ask most 
was...
choice_data_list: Why did you suddenly disappear like that?
Why did you suddenly disappear like that?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"...Sorry. Why did I vanish? Just my usual 
whim. That's right—"

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I intentionally chose to step away from 
you and from racing. Because...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Stay... Because I felt stagnant. Because 
winning a European GⅠ made my goals 
disappear. And—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I've found it: a new breakthrough.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeking the Pearl shared a new dream with 
me.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Taiki and I aimed for the world. That was 
a wonderful era in its own right, but...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, don't you think it's 
a bit old-fashioned? Having to physically 
travel out into the world just to compete, 
I mean.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Indeed, this Earth...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
As you can see, it's just a single ball. 
It should be able to move back and forth 
more freely. Yes...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"Instead of just us going abroad, we 
should send out more invitations to 
overseas Umamusume."

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
If we do that—we can compete with the 
world right here at home.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Opening up the Twinkle Series to 
everyone. This is the new possibility I 
have discovered!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
On a rainy day at this ranch, after nearly 
getting struck by lightning, the idea hit 
me.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Let's open the country! Let that be our 
next accomplishment, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems Seeking the Pearl plans to draw 
in the world with a brand-new approach.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Come on over here, girl.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Called upon, the quiet girl from earlier 
walked over.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
While we're heading back, I'll take this 
little one along too. She lives here at 
this ranch.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
She's still a diamond in the rough and 
struggles to secure wins, but she has a 
great stride. Yes, in this one too...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I sense the makings of a seeker in you. 
Somewhat like myself, you see.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Time to head back, Trainer. Let's return!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Tickets for three, please! One is a child 
ticket!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Ohohoho! Come, another day of training 
with the Pearl Family!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Strong Umamusume from overseas will be 
rushing in one after another! Hey, let's 
battle!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, thanks to Seeking the Pearl, many 
more Umamusume began coming from overseas.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"This, too, is a new possibility. With 
racing as a rainbow, the worlds that were 
once so far apart— have connected into 
one."
